name: Export document check
summary: Turns an export shipment's details into a DRAFT commercial invoice in Xero, checks that invoice against the shipment record, and queues the authorise-and-email step for approval. Crons read and draft; a person approves every send.

export-document-set.evidence: 1 discovery call describes this way of preparing export documents

covered_by.cross-check: draft (reads the Xero invoice against the record)
covered_by.internal-approval: approval (a person sets the record to approved)

crons.name: draft
crons.summary: New shipment records get a DRAFT commercial invoice in Xero. Records without lines wait for details.

crons.name: cross-check
crons.summary: Compare each drafted invoice with its shipment record and flag any difference.

crons.name: send
crons.summary: Approved and checked shipments get their authorise-and-email step queued for approval.

draft_ops_note: Draft operations reach nobody outside the business: a buyer contact and a DRAFT sales invoice in Xero, plus reads. Authorising an invoice and emailing it to the buyer are live operations and wait for a person.

xero.covers: commercial invoice draft, cross-check read, authorise and email (queued)

gaps: Microsoft 365: the evidence says the docs do not cover export shipping steps, and no shipping operation is mapped for it. No adapter built.
Packing lists and export certificates (phytosanitary, certificate of origin, inspection): no mapped operation. Agent skill steps for now.
Xero's guide says a commercial invoice is a different document from a sales invoice. This draft uses a sales invoice, so confirm the format with the buyer or forwarder before use.
GST and export tax type are not set on the draft lines. Confirm the correct tax treatment with the client's accountant before any invoice is authorised.
Record-keeping: accounting.createInvoiceAttachmentByFileName is mapped, but the shipment document pack needs file bytes from the shell, so it is not wired.
Payment matching: accounting.createPayment and getPayments are mapped, but recording a payment moves money, so it needs its own approval design. Not wired.
Shipment records (lots, weights, consignee) come from the CRM shell or the agent. No intake cron because no evidence platform holds them.
The evidence file agriculture-mining-shipdocs-variants.json is missing from the evidence folder. Steps and families come from the spec and one call only.
The Xero adapter is docs-only until a demo company proves it.

evidence.platforms: Xero help guides: partial support for the commercial invoice, sending and payment steps. Microsoft 365: docs do not cover shipping documents.
